$description: Layout, grids, sizes, iconography and interaction constants.

com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

layout.$description: Layout: containers, page rhythm, header metrics and grids for web, mobile and print.

sm.$description: Narrow forms, toasts on large screens.

prose.$description: Prose, section ledes, narrow sections, articles.

form.$description: Maximum width of a form column.

dialog.$description: Maximum width of a dialog card.

compact.$description: Page side margin at 480px and below, and on phones.

regular.$description: Page side margin at 1280px and above.

fluid.$description: Page side margin on the web: clamp(24px, 5vw, 64px). Native platforms use the compact value.

height-fluid.$description: Header height on the web: clamp(80px, 5vw + 40px, 110px).

inset-compact.$description: Header side inset at small viewports.

inset-regular.$description: Header side inset at 1334px and above.

inset-fluid.$description: Header side inset on the web: clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px).

col-pad-top-min.$description: Space above the first block of a page column. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

col-pad-top-max.$description: Space above the first block of a page column. Maximum.

col-pad-top.$description: Space above the first block of a page column. Web: clamp(104px, 14vh, 212px).

stage-pad-bottom-min.$description: Space below the stage. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

stage-pad-bottom.$description: Space below the stage. Web: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px).

home-gap-min.$description: Gap between home sections. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

home-gap.$description: Gap between home sections. Web: clamp(64px, 9vw, 112px).

article-gap-min.$description: Gap between article sections. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

article-gap.$description: Gap between article sections. Web: clamp(64px, 8vw, 100px).

hero-gap-min.$description: Gap inside the hero. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

hero-gap.$description: Gap inside the hero. Web: clamp(32px, 4vw, 64px).

footer-margin-top-min.$description: Space above the footer. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

footer-margin-top.$description: Space above the footer. Web: clamp(64px, 10vh, 112px).

footer-pad-top-min.$description: Footer top padding. Minimum; native platforms use this value.

section-gap.$description: Gap between a section title and its content.

web.$description: Web page grid by width class (regular = above breakpoint.md).

mobile.$description: Native mobile grid (iOS points, Android dp).

tablet-min-width.$description: Width at which the tablet grid applies.

content-bottom-extra.$description: Extra space added to the platform safe-area inset below scrolling content (web: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + this value).

visualization-workbench.$description: Responsive workflow visualization: controls stay in a touch-sized rail, art takes the flexible track, and reading detail moves to a bottom sheet when a readable side column will not fit.

rail-inline-padding.$description: Inline inset on the control rail, one space.1 at each edge.

rail-touch-min.$description: Minimum width and height for each rail control's interactive target.

rail-width.$description: Control rail width: 44px touch minimum plus the 4px inline inset on both sides (rail-touch-min + 2 × rail-inline-padding).

gap.$description: Gap between the control rail, art viewport and reading panel on wide workbenches.

compact-gap.$description: Gap between the control rail and flexible art viewport at phone widths.

reading-min-width.$description: Minimum reading-panel track: leaves a 320px text measure after the existing 32px panel padding on both sides.

reading-preferred-width.$description: Preferred reading-panel track: leaves a 384px text measure after the existing 32px panel padding on both sides.

reading-breakpoint.$description: At and below breakpoint.lg, remove reading text from the squeezed column layout and present it in component.bottom-sheet.

card-columns-medium.$description: List-card grid columns from 641px to 860px (source switch at 900px).

card-columns-compact.$description: List-card grid columns at 640px and below (source switch at 560px).

pinboard-fill-min.$description: Minimum pin width in the auto-fill pinboard.

post-min.$description: Minimum post-card width in the auto-fill post grid.

facts-min.$description: Minimum fact width in auto-fit fact grids.

footer-columns-regular.$description: Footer grid columns above 1180px (source switch at 1000px).

footer-columns-compact.$description: Footer flows in 2 CSS columns at 860px and below (source switch at 700px).

specs-label-compact.$description: Spec list term column width at 860px and below.

board-score-compact.$description: Leaderboard score column at 640px and below.

field-row-columns.$description: Form field row columns (1 at 640px and below).

size.$description: Fixed sizes of controls, targets, dots and media.

md.$description: Medium control height; nav thumbnails and 'all' link.

lg.$description: Large control height; inputs and search fields on touch.

min.$description: Minimum touch target on iOS and the web (menu items, nav toggle height).

inline-min.$description: Minimum height of inline text links (WCAG 2.5.8).

nav.$description: Current-page dot after a navigation link; active tab-bar dot.

tag.$description: Colour dot inside a dot tag.

highlight.$description: Highlight-row dot, relative to the row font size (em).

player-compact.$description: Media player stage height at 640px and below.

player-inline-compact.$description: Inline media player stage height at 640px and below.

use-case-shot.$description: App screenshot height in use-case blocks.

hero-photo-min-height-compact.$description: Fill-hero photo minimum height at 860px and below.

result-min-compact.$description: Result panel minimum height at 832px and below.

viewport.$description: Reference viewports for mockups, specimens and screenshot tests (not breakpoints).

width.$description: Phone in landscape (a short viewport). Width.

height.$description: Phone in landscape (a short viewport). Height.

keyboard.$description: On-screen keyboard. A focused field stays in view with gap below it; bottom bars (the tab bar) give way while the keyboard is open; sheets, toasts and bars that belong to the field ride above it. Web: the layout viewport resizes with the keyboard (meta viewport interactive-widget=resizes-content) and reference/keyboard.js reads the visual viewport where the browser lays the keyboard over the page. iOS and Android move content themselves (the SwiftUI keyboard safe area; Compose imePadding and WindowInsets.ime).

gap.$description: Space kept between the focused field, or a bar riding on the keyboard, and the keyboard's top edge.

threshold.$description: Web: the visual viewport must lose at least this much height before the page treats the keyboard as open (smaller changes are browser toolbars).

icon.$description: Iconography: 24-unit line icons, round caps and joins, stroke in currentColor; filled glyphs (play, pause) in currentColor.

24.$description: Button icons, tab-bar icons, app-bar icons.

fine.$description: Globe and outline glyphs. Units of the 24-unit viewBox; round caps and joins.

caret.$description: Carets and select chevrons (12-unit grid). Units of the 24-unit viewBox; round caps and joins.

regular.$description: Default icon stroke (copy, arrows). Units of the 24-unit viewBox; round caps and joins.

arrow.$description: Button arrows. Units of the 24-unit viewBox; round caps and joins.

bold.$description: Check marks and nav chevrons. Units of the 24-unit viewBox; round caps and joins.

com.desertpants.note: The source draws its own inline icons; desert-pants substitutes Lucide at the same 24-unit grid and stroke weights. icons/manifest.json lists the curated set and the components that use each icon.

offset.$description: Default focus ring offset (buttons, cards, links).

offset-tight.$description: Focus ring offset for inputs, menu items, chips.

offset-inset.$description: Inset focus ring for full-card hit areas.

offset-inset-tight.$description: Inset focus ring for rows inside a scrolling list (transcript lines).

offset-wide.$description: Focus ring offset around the round play button.

card.$description: Hover lift of cards and prompt cards (translateY negative).

pin.$description: Hover lift of pins and post cards.

settle.$description: Hover lift of settling tilted cards.

reveal.$description: Start offset of rise-in reveals (translateY positive).

drop.$description: Start offset of drop-loader cells (translateY negative).

settle.$description: Scale of a settling tilted card on hover.

play-hover.$description: Scale of the play button on hover.

copied-from.$description: Start scale of the copied overlay.

pulse-peak.$description: Peak scale of the heartbeat ring.

fan-start.$description: First card in a compact fan.

fan-end.$description: Last card in a compact fan.

settle-factor.$description: Tilt multiplier while settling on hover: a tilted card straightens to this share of its tilt, not flat.

forward.$description: Chevron pointing forward (see-all links, list rows).

close.$description: Hamburger lines crossing into a close icon (+/-45).

overlap.$description: Overlap between cards in a regular-width fan (negative margin).

hover-dim.$description: Navigation links dim to 60% on hover.

fill-button-hover.$description: Filled button on a fill hero at 88% on hover.

anchor-hint.$description: Heading anchor while the heading is hovered.

copy.$description: Invisible padding that grows the 28px copy button to a 44px target on touch.

drag-slop.$description: Web: pointer travel before a touch becomes a drag (bottom-sheet grabber, slider thumb, swipe rows, pull to refresh); it also cancels a long press. Native platforms use the system touch slop.

long-press.$description: Web: hold time before a press becomes a long press (it opens the item's context menu). iOS and Android use their system recognisers (0.5 s on iOS; ViewConfiguration.getLongPressTimeout on Android).

fling-velocity.$description: A release faster than this completes a swipe or dismissal whatever the distance travelled (px per ms: 500 pt/s on iOS, 500 dp/s on Android).

rubber-band.$description: Resistance past a limit: a drag beyond the end of its travel moves the content by this share of the finger's movement.

edge-exclusion.$description: Horizontal swipe gestures start at least this far from the screen's side edges, where the system back gesture lives (Android: at least WindowInsets.systemGestures).

screen.$description: Distance a screen travels in a forward or back transition as it fades (motion.animation.screen-*).

modal.$description: Distance a full-screen modal rises as it fades in (motion.animation.modal-in).

com.desertpants.note: Hover effects apply only where the hover-capable query matches; touch screens use pressed states.
